sources: Esri World Imagery z18 with the catalog site coordinates

values.note: The catalog lists 25 sites: 9 tent-only and 16 that take RVs. Of those 16, twelve are catalogued at 25 ft or more (to 45 ft on 015; 027 and 028 read 99, a placeholder) and four at 20 ft (007, 009, 018, 019). 002 (40 ft) is a pull-through. One camping unit per site. FS publishes no length.

sites.source: recreation.gov catalog 232153 (site types, Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry Pull-Through on 002) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232153 (notice 'Recreation Use Fee allows ONE camping unit ONLY'), read 2026-10-28

hookups.source: recreation.gov catalog 232153 (every site RV NONELECTRIC, STANDARD NONELECTRIC or TENT ONLY NONELECTRIC), read 2026-10-28

values.note: No water: bring your own. Firewood $10 a bundle.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/gmug/recreation/lake-irwin-campground-gunnison-rd ('No water available'; 'Vault toilet(s)'; 'Potable water is not available at this site'; '$10 per firewood bundle') + recreation.gov ('Currently no water is provided, please bring your own'), read 2026-10-28

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/gmug/recreation/lake-irwin-campground-gunnison-rd ('Seasons of Use: June 13 - Oct. 3', last updated September 28, 2026) + recreation.gov notice ('Opening and closing dates are weather permitting'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: A mix of reservable and first-come sites; the whole campground is first-come from opening to mid-July and for the last weeks of September (2026: Jun 15 - Jul 16 and Sep 13-27). First-come sites are booked in person only. Booking closes 4 days before arrival; two nights on weekends (not marked soft). A late reservation is held 24 hours. Extra vehicles paid to the host on arrival.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232153 (rules minWeekendStay 2, reservationCutOff 4; notices 'FIRST COME FIRST SERVE sites must be booked in person', 'Late Arrivals ... 24 hours', 'Extra Vehicles') + /rates (2026 First-come 06-15 to 07-16, Peak 07-17 to 09-12, First-come 09-13 to 09-27) + FS page ('a combination of first come, first serve and reservable campsites'), read 2026-10-28

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232153/rates (2026 Peak and First-come RV/STANDARD NONELECTRIC 24; 2028 24) + FS page ('$24 per night per camping unit'), read 2026-10-28

note: GMUG campground at ~10,200 ft at the end of FR 826 (Lake Irwin Road), 2 mi off Kebler Pass Road (CR 12) and about 9 mi from Crested Butte, on the west shore of Lake Irwin below the Ruby Range; most sites shaded by spruce and fir. Non-motorized boating. The last 2 miles are dusty and washboarded; campers report 27-34 ft rigs fitting. --Claude
summary: FS page + recreation.gov: confirmed no electric, vault toilets, no water, mixed reservable/first-come, $24 (2026). Added 25 sites (16 take RVs) with max 45 (catalog; 99s ignored), pull-through, season 06-13..10-03 (FS), booking.season 07-17..09-12, 2-night weekend minimum, 4-day cutoff. Note trimmed of field facts.
flags: Missing phone: Gunnison Ranger District (970) 641-0471 (GMUG offices page; the campground's FS page has no office block). recreation.gov gives 970-349-6348 as the facility phone and (928) 537-8888 for information (the concessionaire, rrmofa.com).
Max length: no agency figure. Catalog per-site lengths 20-45 ft plus two 99-ft placeholders (027, 028); recorded 45. Four RV sites are 20 ft.

Road: neither FS nor recreation.gov carries RV or 4WD wording for CR 12 / FR 826 ('Continue on FSR 826 for 2 miles, the campground is at the end of the road'). The 'dusty and washboarded' text is camper-reported, kept in the note as such. No GMUG alert names CR 12, FR 826 or the campground.

Waterfront re-audit lead (stored lakefront): recreation.gov 'situated on the western banks' and 'Lake Irwin borders the campground on the east'. On Esri imagery the nearest RV site, 004 (first-come, 30 ft), is ~45-50 m from the water's edge across an open slope with scattered conifers and a shoreline path, at the open-apron distance bound; 003, 006/007 and 009 are ~65-90 m back behind tree cover, and the west loops are 150 m+. Only 004 (and perhaps 003) could earn lakefront; the rest read lakeview.
Operator: concessionaire-run (recreation.gov contact rrmofa.com). Ownership federal stands.
Pin 38.88107,-107.10696 is 58 m from the catalog site centroid; the FS page coordinate 38.879259,-107.107376 is at the south entrance by site 001. OK.
